# Bony Amin — Design Engineer

> I'm a design engineer. I bring product design and frontend engineering together to
> turn complex workflows into intuitive, polished, working software. I do both the
> design and the implementation, so what ships is what was designed.

## Who I work with
Companies looking for someone who bridges product design and frontend engineering,
either as a team member or on freelance and contract projects. My product background is
in logistics, transportation and operational systems.

## Experience
Around five years of product design work, spanning logistics, transportation and digital
products, collaborating with product and engineering teams, with a focus on
design-to-development implementation.

## Services
- Product design — turning complex requirements and user workflows into intuitive
  interfaces, from early concepts to detailed product experiences.
- Frontend implementation — responsive layouts, reusable components and carefully
  crafted interactions.
- Design systems — consistent design foundations and component libraries that make
  products easier to maintain and extend.

## Process
1. Understand — user needs, business goals, existing workflows and real constraints.
2. Design — map journeys, explore solutions, refine interactions, validate key decisions.
3. Build — responsive interfaces, reusable components, correct interaction behaviour.
4. Iterate — evaluate usability, review implementation, learn from feedback, improve.

## Selected work
- TL Ops — Challan Workflow. Enterprise UX, logistics, workflow design. Digitising the
  challan submission and review process into a structured digital experience. Shipped.
- Truck Lagbe — Home Shifting. Transportation, service design, mobile UX. Integrating a
  home-shifting service into an existing transportation platform, connecting service
  discovery to booking. Shipped.
- Shohoz — Bus Booking Redesign. Travel, interaction design, mobile UX. A self-directed
  redesign of journey clarity, seat selection, visual hierarchy and accessibility.
  Self-directed redesign, not shipped production work.

## Availability
Open to design engineering roles on product teams, and to freelance and contract
projects covering design, implementation, or both. Replies within one business day.
